questions.q: What were the apostles to wait for in Jerusalem?
questions.a: To be baptized with the Holy Ghost

questions.q: Upon whom did the lot fall to replace Judas?
On which day did the Holy Ghost come upon the disciples?
What sat upon each of them at Pentecost?
questions.a: Cloven tongues like as of fire

questions.q: About how many souls were added that day?
'Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee.' What did Peter give the lame man?
questions.a: Healing in the name of Jesus Christ

questions.q: Which husband and wife lied about the price of their land?
Who saw the heavens opened as he was stoned?
At whose feet did the witnesses lay down their clothes?
Whom did Philip baptize on the road to Gaza?
Near which city did a light from heaven stop Saul?
Who was sent to put his hands on Saul, that he might receive his sight?
What did Peter see let down from heaven on the housetop?
questions.a: A great sheet full of beasts

questions.q: Which centurion of Caesarea sent for Peter?
Where were the disciples first called Christians?
Who brought Peter out of prison?
What were Paul and Silas doing at midnight in the prison at Philippi?
'Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and...' — what did they tell the jailer?
questions.a: Thou shalt be saved, and thy house

questions.q: In which city did Paul find an altar TO THE UNKNOWN GOD?
What happened to the ship carrying Paul toward Rome?
questions.a: It broke apart, but all escaped safe to land
